comparison.objective: Clamp a bar and drill a marked through-hole safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual workholding, screw-clamp tightening, quill operation, and hazard clearance.
comparison.success_condition: A through-hole is within 5 mm of the mark, the bar stays clamped, and hands remain clear of the spinning bit.
comparison.reason: Workpiece clamping and drilling do not test staged spring-prong rail latching or alignment between rack posts. Candidate insertion-force and damage thresholds are not numeric.
